verdict.rationale: Mercury documents a dedicated REST API covering core accounting objects—transactions, categories, statements, merchants, treasury (mercury-docs-12) and a full Accounts Receivable API for customers/invoices/webhooks/events (mercury-docs-13)—plus OAuth2 and scoped API tokens for programmatic access (mercury-docs-15, mercury-docs-20). This is corroborated by a hands-on probe of Mercury's official CLI exposing matching resource commands (accounts, categories, customers, invoices, statements, transactions, treasury, webhooks) (mercury-probe-3), and QuickBooks/Xero/NetSuite sync for bookkeeping (mercury-docs-6). Missing for 10: a publicly discoverable OpenAPI/swagger spec (probe found only 404s at standard paths) and independent developer reviews specifically praising the accounting-data API endpoints themselves.
